tools.name: nexatabs_overview
tools.description: Read-only product snapshot for NexaTabs (name, display title, Chrome and Edge only, version, pricing, local-first model, publisher, store/site/docs/Answers links, Answer and Feature counts). Use for a company/product brief; use nexatabs_search for ranked queries, nexatabs_list to browse titles/URLs,

tools.name: nexatabs_search
tools.description: Read-only ranked keyword search across Answers, Features, and blog posts from the NexaTabs KB. Use when you have a query; use nexatabs_list to browse without ranking, nexatabs_get for one record, nexatabs_overview for a summary. Optional locale filters Answers (en/de/fr/es). Returns query, results[{

tools.name: nexatabs_list
tools.description: Read-only browse of Answers, Features, or blog (title, url, section, date when present). Use to page through a section; use nexatabs_search for ranked queries, nexatabs_get for full text, nexatabs_overview for a summary. Unknown section values are rejected. Returns items[{title,url,section,date?}],

tools.name: nexatabs_get
tools.description: Read-only fetch of one Answer or Feature by slug or URL, including its full text fields from the KB. Use when you know the slug/URL from search or list; use nexatabs_search to find candidates, nexatabs_list to browse, nexatabs_overview for a product snapshot.
